title: CreativeWorkSeason
description: A media season, e.g. TV, radio, video game etc.

type.title: Type
type.description: The RDF type(s) of this item.

actor.title: Actor
actor.description: An actor (individual or a group), e.g. in TV, radio, movie, video games etc., or in an event. Actors can be associated with individual items or with a series, episode, clip.

director.title: Director
director.description: A director of e.g. TV, radio, movie, video gaming etc. content, or of an event. Directors can be associated with individual items or with a series, episode, clip.

endDate.title: End Date
endDate.description: The end date and time of the item (in [ISO 8601 date format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)).

episode.title: Episode
episode.description: An episode of a TV, radio or game media within a series or season.

numberOfEpisodes.title: Number Of Episodes
numberOfEpisodes.description: The number of episodes in this season or series.

partOfSeries.title: Part Of Series
partOfSeries.description: The series to which this episode or season belongs.

productionCompany.title: Production Company
productionCompany.description: The production company or studio responsible for the item, e.g. series, video game, episode etc.

seasonNumber.title: Season Number
seasonNumber.description: Position of the season within an ordered group of seasons.

startDate.title: Start Date
startDate.description: The start date and time of the item (in [ISO 8601 date format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)).

trailer.title: Trailer
trailer.description: The trailer of a movie or TV/radio series, season, episode, etc.
